details:
Dear VRChat Team,

I’m a longtime user who truly appreciates everything VRChat has built a creative, social platform where people can connect, express themselves, and enjoy virtual experiences together.

To help make the community even safer and more welcoming for EVERYONE, I’d like to respectfully suggest a new optional feature: the ability for users to create or join “affinity instances” or tagged groups based on shared personal values, beliefs, or viewpoints (including political or ideological perspectives).

This would be completely voluntary. Users could choose to enter these affinity spaces for respectful, low-conflict conversations with others who share similar outlooks, while public, friends+, and mixed instances would remain fully available for anyone who prefers diverse interactions or open debate. Moderation tools (block, mute, instance rules) would still apply everywhere, of course.

The goal is simple: give users more control over their own social environment so they can avoid unwanted harassment or disruption based on differing opinions. This kind of user-empowered grouping already exists in many online communities and has proven to reduce overall toxicity while encouraging healthier dialogue across the board.

I believe this feature would align perfectly with VRChat’s values of creativity, freedom, and user safety, and it would benefit players of every background by letting each person curate the kind of experience they feel most comfortable in.

Thank you for reading this suggestion and for all the hard work you put into keeping VRChat an amazing place for everyone regardless of their beliefs and opinions.
title: Feature Suggestion – Optional Affinity-Based Safe Spaces for Shared Views
